item.title: Marky 1.1.0
item.description:
What's new

  • Automatic updates. Marky now checks for new versions and installs them for you. Use Marky → Check for Updates…, or switch automatic checks off in Settings → General. (1.0.0 can't update itself, so install this version by hand once.)
  • Quick Look follows your settings: appearance, font, size, width and code highlighting.
  • Same-name tabs show their folder, for example hardware › README.md.
  • Arrow keys in the Files list: → opens a folder, ← closes it or goes to the parent folder.
